subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Hi Samir — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking us through BrightLayer's ingestion and search flow. Quick recap and a few asks so we can finalize a tailored pricing estimate.

Call recap (high level):
- Primary feature: chat assistant inside product (customer support + guided workflows).
- Secondary: embeddings for semantic search and similarity scoring.
- Tertiary: occasional reranking for prioritized search results.

What we need to confirm from you:
1) Monthly token volumes by model type (ballpark is fine) — this drives unit economics. From the call I captured: chat ~25M tokens/mo, embeddings ~5M tokens/mo, rerank ~2M tokens/mo. Please correct if off.
2) Target unit economics / $ per 1M tokens you want to achieve (helps us surface Dedicated vs Hosted / reserved capacity options). You mentioned a target of roughly $10–$15 / 1M tokens for chat. Can you confirm a range for chat + embeddings + rerank?
3) Any hard constraints: PCI/PHI/PII handling, retention windows, or regional residency requirements.

Initial model mix + target pricing (proposal we discussed):
- Chat (chat-completion style): 25M tokens/mo — target $/1M: $12–$15
- Embeddings (vector store updates & queries): 5M tokens/mo — target $/1M: $25–$35
- Rerank (short sequences, high QPS spikes): 2M tokens/mo — target $/1M: $10–$12

Notes & assumptions:
- Volumes above are monthly. If BrightLayer is willing to commit quarterly/annual reserved capacity we can offer stepped discounts and SLA commitments.
- Embeddings unit economics often depend on vector dimensionality and whether you batch offline vs real-time.

Attachments: I attached a short pricing workbook (redwood_pricing_estimate_v3.xlsx) that includes per-model unit costs for Hosted vs Dedicated and an example 1-year spend projection. Also attached a sample token profile CSV to show the breakdown we used for estimates.

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm monthly token splits and target $/1M ranges (reply inline)
- We: follow up with a 1-page commercial summary + recommended deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated) and an optional reserved capacity term sheet
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up technical sync with one of our infra engineers to validate latency SLOs and any model quantization constraints. Please share a few times that work.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet summary of unit economics)
Attachment: ml_token_profile.csv (CSV of token size distribution used in calc)

From: Samir Gupta <samir@brightlayer.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecorp.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Quick clarifications inline.

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - Chat (chat-completion style): 25M tokens/mo — target $/1M: $12–$15

That chat number is close to what we saw in the pilot but it's actually expected to ramp: next 90 days we expect to hit ~60M tokens/mo (mostly user messages + assistant output) as product usage increases. The 25M was our early pilot baseline.

> - Embeddings (vector store updates & queries): 5M tokens/mo — target $/1M: $25–$35

Embeddings look right for queries, but we also have a large offline reindex job monthly that will add ~8M tokens for index rebuilds (batch). Can you model that separately (real-time vs batch)?

> - Rerank (short sequences, high QPS spikes): 2M tokens/mo — target $/1M: $10–$12

Rerank may be higher during holiday spikes; plan for 5x peak vs baseline for architecture sizing but we expect average ~3M tokens/mo.

Other items:
- Procurement / legal: looping in Elena from our procurement team for pricing and NDAs. Elena — can you confirm BrightLayer's preferred contract term (12 vs 36 months) and whether reserved capacity is acceptable?
- SLA: We will need 99.9% uptime and a latency SLO — can Redwood provide guidance on which deployment modes support that and the typical cost delta?

If you can update the workbook with the ramp to 60M chat and the extra 8M embeddings batch job, that will help our finance team model the numbers. Also please include example committed discounts for 12/24/36 month terms.

–Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Product, BrightLayer
samir@brightlayer.ai | +1 (617) 555-0122

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@brightlayer.ai>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Thanks Samir — super helpful. Elena — welcome, and happy to align on term length and procurement checklist.

Actions we've taken and next steps:
- Updated the pricing workbook to include a ramp scenario (chat: 25M -> 60M over 90 days) and a separate "embeddings batch" line + dedicated monthly batch cost. Updated file name: redwood_pricing_estimate_v3.xlsx (attached).
- Attached ml_token_profile.csv (shows the token distribution assumptions we used).
- Draft commercial options included in the workbook: Hosted (pay-as-you-go), Dedicated Reserved (1yr/3yr term options with stepped discounts), and Dedicated committed with autoscaling buffer. Each tab shows $/1M unit rates and example monthly/annual spend.

Answers to your questions:
- SLA & latency: 99.9% uptime is available on Dedicated with an enterprise SLA. Typical latency SLOs depend on the model choice and quantization; we'll confirm with the infra engineer in the technical sync. Hosted can support lower commitments but gives you faster time-to-value. We'll surface the expected tail-latency percentiles in the tech call.
- Contract term: we can provide examples for 12/24/36 month terms with tiered committed discounts. For a 12-month committed tier at the volumes you've outlined we can show a 12–18% discount vs pure hosted list; 24/36 month terms increase the discount. Exact numbers in the attached workbook.

Proposed next steps (concrete):
1) You confirm you want us to model the ramp to 60M chat + +8M embeddings batch + 3M avg rerank.
2) We schedule a 30-min engineering sync with Vivek next week to validate latency / quantization constraints. Here are times that work for Vivek: Thu Nov 12 11:00–12:00 or Fri Nov 13 09:00–10:00 PT. Please share your availability.
3) Once you confirm volumes & preferred term length, we'll send a 1-page commercial summary and a Docusign for signatures if you want to proceed.

I've also created a draft HubSpot opportunity (link below) so we can track next steps and procurement artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
